title: 2.2 HTML Links
description: Hyperlinks, the anchor tag, URL types and same-page links

questions.question: HTML links are used to navigate from one webpage to another or from one part of a webpage to another. What are such links normally known as?
HTML links can come in the form of what?
How can hyperlinks easily be distinguished on a webpage?
options: The mouse cursor turns into a hand symbol when hovering over them
They are displayed in uppercase letters
They always open in a new tab
questions.correctAnswer: The mouse cursor turns into a hand symbol when hovering over them

questions.question: Which tag is used to create hyperlinks in HTML?
In the anchor tag, which attribute is the URL of the destination webpage assigned to?
What does URL stand for?
A URL is used to reference what?
options: The address of the linked webpage
The size of the linked image
The title of the browser tab
questions.correctAnswer: The address of the linked webpage

questions.question: Consider the code Google. What is displayed on the web browser?
What is the output of the code ethio telecom?
options: The text 'ethio telecom' is displayed and clicking it opens the ethio telecom website
The URL is displayed as plain text
The ethio telecom logo is displayed
Nothing is displayed on the browser
questions.correctAnswer: The text 'ethio telecom' is displayed and clicking it opens the ethio telecom website

questions.question: Which attribute of the anchor tag determines where the linked document is displayed?
What does the target value '_self' mean?
options: The webpage is displayed in the same window/tab
The webpage is displayed in a separate window/tab
The webpage is downloaded to the computer
The webpage is displayed as plain text
questions.correctAnswer: The webpage is displayed in the same window/tab

questions.question: What does the target value '_blank' mean?
options: The webpage is displayed in a separate window/tab
The webpage is displayed in the same window/tab
The webpage is not displayed at all
The webpage is displayed inside the anchor tag
questions.correctAnswer: The webpage is displayed in a separate window/tab

questions.question: What is the effect of the code Google?
options: The link opens Google in a separate window or tab
The link opens Google in the same window or tab
The link displays the URL instead of the word Google
questions.correctAnswer: The link opens Google in a separate window or tab

questions.question: To use an image as a link, where is the image element placed?
What is an absolute URL?
options: A URL that includes every element of a URL such as the protocol, hostname and path
A URL that is given relative to the current webpage
A URL that contains only the file name
A URL that points to an image only
questions.correctAnswer: A URL that includes every element of a URL such as the protocol, hostname and path

questions.question: What is a relative URL?
options: A path given relative to the location of the current webpage
A URL that includes the protocol and hostname
A URL that always starts with http://
A URL that points to a different website
questions.correctAnswer: A path given relative to the location of the current webpage

questions.question: In the image link example, google.png is referenced using which type of URL?
Links to page sections are especially useful for what kind of webpage?
options: A webpage that has a large size content
A webpage that contains a single line
A webpage that is hosted offline
questions.correctAnswer: A webpage that has a large size content

questions.question: In links to page sections, which attribute is used to designate a name to a location?
In links to page sections, which attribute is used to create links to the locations?
In the code Go to section one, what does the value '#section_one' mean?
options: The link jumps to an element named section_one on the same page
The link opens a file named section_one.html
The link goes to a website named section_one
The link changes the text to section one
questions.correctAnswer: The link jumps to an element named section_one on the same page

questions.question: What is the effect of the code Back to top on a long webpage?
options: It moves the user to the element named top on the same page
It opens a new webpage named top
It sends the user to a website called top
It displays the text '#top' on the page
questions.correctAnswer: It moves the user to the element named top on the same page

questions.question: True or False: text and images can both be used as hyperlinks
True or False: a relative URL includes the protocol and hostname
True or False: _self is the default value of the target attribute
True or False: an absolute URL is given relative to the location of the current webpage
